item: A hostless Origin is refused on state changes, and a 422 no longer echoes the request body
summary: The CSRF guard allowed a present Origin or Referer that names no host (Origin: null from a sandboxed iframe or file:// page, about:blank, data:, empty) because it read no hostname as no header, and a loopback Referer could vouch for a null Origin. Only an absent header is allowed now; when sent, the Origin decides alone and must name a loopback host. A RequestValidationError handler answers 422 with type, loc and msg (msg scrubbed) and drops input and ctx for every route, so a missing field on a passphrase route (create-db, encrypt-db, unlock, backup, release run) no longer returns the passphrase in the response; the UI reads only msg. 16 cases, 13 red on the old code. No middleware or logger writes bodies. Not browser-verified (no file:// client in the shell tests).
